list: the official 55 trophies, as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them on 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task. Follow the roadmap in this guide: finish the story first (Step 1), then the 100% Completion checklist (Step 2), then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup (Step 3). PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours in a single playthrough, with no online trophies and no difficulty settings.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Gone Fishing is the opening mission — play through it and the trophy pops when it ends. It is the first mission of Chapter 1, so it comes naturally at the start of the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the last mission of Chapter 1 ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in the game that can be missed: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, follow her when she mentions meditating, and accept the balcony meditation for the Positive Mental Attitude trophy.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the last mission of Chapter 2 ends. Keep a separate save at the start and end of every chapter: there is no mission replay, so a spare save is your only way back if you want to redo a story beat.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the last mission of Chapter 3 ends. Along the way, pick up optional missions as they appear (purple icons, plus black icons with pink letters) and scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app: both count toward the 100% checklist later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the last mission of Chapter 4 ends. The story runs to five chapters and takes roughly 60–80 hours, so this is the last chapter trophy before the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the final mission ends and the credits roll. After the story there is still free-roam, and everything needed for 100% Completion stays accessible, so the finale locks nothing out.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the mission Breakfast Run ends. Story missions come in order, so there is nothing to look up: keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the mission The Cartel Heist ends. Heist missions are story beats, so this one needs no preparation beyond playing through the chapter it sits in.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the mission Child's Play ends. Like the other mission trophies it is tied to story progress only, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the mission Headliners ends. Keep a chapter-start save if you want to replay the mission later; the game has no mission replay of its own.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the mission VCIA Takedown ends. VCIA is Vice City International Airport; the mission is a story beat there, and the trophy follows from finishing it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable — it pops when the mission Operation Savage Glory ends. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies before the chapter and finale trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy, per PowerPyx. After the story, Progress > Stats gains a 100% Completion entry that lists what is left. It is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly. You do need every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and the Bret quest — plus 200 of the 277 base vehicle models scanned, 100 of the 255 animals studied, and 70 of the 80 Challenges. Do the story first; everything you do before the ending already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near-misses, drifts, airtime and similar driving feats — the counter climbs across the whole game, in missions and free roam alike. Chain them on long straight roads and jump ramps: an airport runway run with jumps and near-misses racks them up fast. 250 sounds like a lot, but a normal playthrough plus some deliberate stunt driving gets there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample each of the game's nine activity types once — races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting and the bar games are the kinds the game counts. The trophy pops as soon as the ninth different type registers. Any order works and nothing here is missable; work through the Activities filter of this guide and tick each type off as you try it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges, and every one needs a gold medal. Gold is scored on accuracy and speed: take the steady shots first, aim for the bonus targets, and retry a challenge freely — retries cost nothing and the medal only counts when you beat the gold line. All 42 are also required for 100% Completion, so this is core roadmap work, not a side errand.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations across Leonida — win one race at each. Learn each course's line and boost gates on a practice run, then race to win; a win at a location counts even if you lose the first attempt. Every location is also needed for 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events — each distinct race counts once, so repeating the same race does not help. Mix street, off-road and other race types and vary your vehicle to suit the course. Races unlock as you explore Leonida, and wins in missions do not count toward the 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Fishing challenges pit you against Cal, the rival angler: out-fish his catch total inside the time limit. Better bait and rods unlock as you fish more, so if you lose, fish a few free sessions first and come back with better gear. The challenge can be retried.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade venue and play one game through to its end — finishing is what counts, not a high score. Any cabinet, any game: pick the shortest one and play it out.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's mission strand ends with his final mission — do his missions as they appear (black icons with pink letters). Quest givers can become temporarily unavailable during the story, but every trophy-related character comes back, so a strand that goes quiet is not lost; keep checking the map as the story advances.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's mission strand ends with his final mission — do his missions as they appear. Like the other character strands, his missions can go quiet for stretches of the story and return later; they are not missable, but do not leave them all until after the finale if you can help it.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's mission strand ends with his final mission — do his missions as they appear. His strand is one of the five character strands with a hidden trophy (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), and all five are needed before the platinum.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map; a strand is several missions for the same stranger. Some strands have windows tied to story progress, so start them when they appear rather than saving them all for after the story — the 100% checklist does not ask for these quests, so they are usually what is left at the end.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's mission strand ends with his final mission — do his missions as they appear. His strand is one of the five character strands; if his icon vanishes for a while, that is a story pause, not a lost strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's mission strand ends with his final mission — do his missions as they appear. With Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, Tyrone completes the five character strands; finishing all five is Step 3 of the roadmap.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: The first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, can only be done before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: The one trophy you can miss. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning: she mentions meditating, heads for the balcony — follow her, accept the prompt, and she shows you how it works. That meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and it is unclear whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway: you cannot do it again after Chapter 1. The other spots are marked meditation spots across Leonida — visit all 18 in total.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's quest chain leads to a hunt for one unique animal — follow his clues to its territory, track it, and take it down. Studying animals through your binoculars helps you learn their habits, and the Bret quest is one of the things 100% Completion requires, so do the whole chain rather than just the hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, venues and out-of-the-way spots. A set completes when you hold every card in it; three full sets pop the trophy. There are 15 complete sets in the game, and the full set is part of the 100% collectible objectives, so keep collecting past the third set.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on the in-game phone to scan locations — 100 distinct ones. Scan as you travel instead of saving it for the end: every new place you visit is a chance, and the same app scans vehicles (200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100%). 100 locations are also part of the 100% collectible objectives.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 Challenges in total, across driving, combat, exploration and more — complete any 50. Only 70 are needed for 100% Completion, so you can skip the nastiest ones: pick the easiest 50 from the Progress menu and work through them. Challenges tick up naturally during a long playthrough.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. Use quiet back roads or water to slip the cordon, and do not get spotted again before the stars fade — the escape is the trophy, not the chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row, in one wanted-level run, with your partner along — and keep the wanted level alive between robberies: if it clears or you get busted, the chain breaks. Plan a route of three nearby shops, hit them fast, and stay mobile between them.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning new ones with the WAiNK app as you meet them — parked, driving past, or in traffic. Variety is the point: new models count, repeats do not. 200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100% Completion, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time for a short window — trigger it in a group fight and drop 5 enemies before the meter runs out. Gang operations and heists give you the crowds; line up headshots and do not waste the window moving between cover. It can be retried as often as you like.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, leave by air without a scheduled flight: get a plane airborne from the runway — stealing a parked aircraft and taking off counts as an unscheduled departure. Expect airport security and a wanted level on the way out.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this trophy is built around them. Get behind the wheel of a Rhino — they turn up at military sites and at high wanted levels — and use it; the trophy follows from tank play. If a Rhino will not spawn for you, raise your wanted level in open country and watch for the military response.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean: get in, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Go quiet — no shooting, no smashed alarms, no spotted guards — and plan the exit before the entry. If you are detected, leave and try again; the trophy only counts a fully undetected run.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape the police after each one. Bank vault robberies are part of the robbery set — 100% Completion asks for eight of them, along with 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs and 7 payday loan jobs — so plan a getaway vehicle and route before you crack each vault, and count the escape, not just the robbery.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida. Stop one, breach it, take the cash — then escape the wanted level that follows. A sticky-bomb or heavy weapon opens the truck fastest; have a fast getaway car parked nearby before you strike.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 named areas of Leonida — the map fills in as you go, and the Progress menu tracks the count. Story missions carry you through most of them; the leftovers are the quiet corners, so sweep the map area by area in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs running illegal operations — 39 gang operations in total — and you must rob one operation belonging to each gang. Hit a different gang's operation each time and keep a note of which gangs you have covered; the operations are marked once you scout them.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A quiet-moment trophy: go to a bar or beachfront venue on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view. It pops from the moment itself, not from a mission — a breather between the loud parts of the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car through a vehicle showroom's glass front — the classic GTA showroom smash. Pick a showroom, build speed on the approach, and go straight through the window and out the other side. Any showroom works; the smash is the trophy.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game — the trophy is about the follow-through, so play the game out rather than walking away after one frame. It is one of the nine activity types for Master of None, so it does double duty.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership beat: it pops from a moment with your partner that lands with the public — a story moment, not a grind. Keep playing the story with your partner and it comes on its own; there is nothing to farm for it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — dialogue picks, story decisions, the small calls as well as the big ones. PlayStation tracks a count toward 500 choices, and the trophy pops when the count is reached. Just keep choosing through the story and side content; it accumulates over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something, then succeed on the second try — the trophy is about the retry. The cleanest way is a challenge or activity you can attempt back-to-back: fail it once, then pass it on the immediate retry and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's odd-events set: a UFO-style sighting or another unexplained moment around Leonida. These events are rare and location-tied, so explore the quiet and remote corners at night and keep an eye on the sky; it pops the moment you see it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a moving vehicle, knock someone down with a melee attack — a drive-by with a melee weapon, not a gun. Slow to a crawl beside a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the trophy pops when they go down. Do it away from police unless you want the wanted level that follows.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Robberies pay out in Marked Bills, which you launder through your contacts for clean cash at a cut. Launder $250,000 in total — keep robbing and laundering through the game and the total climbs on its own. The trophy counts the amount laundered, not the amount you keep.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — weapons, clothes, food, vehicle mods, anything with a price tag. It is cumulative across the whole game and counts naturally as you gear up; if you are close at the end, a big-ticket vehicle purchase closes the gap in one go.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. They store your vehicles, and each one costs real money — save up through the story and buy them as you can afford them. The last purchase pops the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone and register vehicles you own or find — 10 in total. Any vehicle you drive counts once registered; work through your garage and the cars you meet on the road.
